segments.sn7.3:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.sn7.3:1.3: “bhāradvājagotto brāhmaṇo kira samaṇassa gotamassa santike agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito”ti kupito anattamano yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ asabbhāhi pharusāhi vācāhi akkosati paribhāsati.
segments.sn7.3:1.5: Atha kho asurindakabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn7.3:2.1: “Jayaṃ ve maññati bālo, vācāya pharusaṃ bhaṇaṃ;
segments.sn7.3:2.3: Jayañcevassa taṃ hoti, yā titikkhā vijānato.
segments.sn7.3:4.3: Paraṃ saṅkupitaṃ ñatvā, yo sato upasammati.
segments.sn7.3:5.3: Janā maññanti bāloti, ye dhammassa akovidā”ti.
segments.sn7.3:6.1: Evaṃ vutte, asurindakabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn7.3:6.4: Aññataro ca panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosī”ti.

lines: Jayañcevassa taṃ hotīti asseva taṃ jayaṃ hoti, so jayo hotīti attho.
Yā titikkhā vijānato adhivāsanāya guṇaṃ vijānantassa titikkhā adhivāsanā, ayaṃ tassa vijānatova jayo.
Bālo pana pharusaṃ bhaṇanto “mayhaṃ jayo”ti kevalaṃ jayaṃ maññati.
“Taṃ jayaṃ hotī”ti liṅgavipallāsavasena vuttanti āha “so jayo hotī”ti, dujjayaṃ kodhaṃ titikkhāya jinantassāti adhippāyo.
Yasmā titikkhādayo na kodhavasikaṃ dhuraṃ, taṃ pana bālānaṃ maññanāmattanti idha imamatthaṃ vibhāvetuṃ “katamassā”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Na hi avijānanto andhabālo kodhaṃ vijetuṃ sakkoti.
Kevalaṃ jayaṃ maññati kilesehi parājito samānopīti adhippāyo.
